question:
**Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.**

The five first minutes of the performance showcased / incredible energy, stunning choreography, and vibrant music /, setting the tone for an unforgettable show filled with / excitement and anticipation.

options.text: incredible energy, stunning choreography, and vibrant music
setting the tone for an unforgettable show filled with
The five first minutes of the performance showcased

solution:
The erroneous part is** 'The five first minutes of the performance showcased'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is in Part: *"The** five first minutes** of the performance showcased."*
 
• The phrase** "the five first minutes"** is not** idiomatic or commonly used in English.** The correct order of **adjectives** for this context would be ***"the first five minutes."***
 
• When describing a specific **period of time,** especially in terms of** sequence or order, the common order of adjectives** in English is* "number + ordinal + noun."* In this case, **"first" (ordinal)** should precede the number **"five" (quantity).**
 
• Corrected phrase: *"the first five minutes"*
 
• **The revised sentence would read:**__* "**The first five minutes of the performance showcased** incredible energy, stunning choreography, and vibrant music, setting the tone for an unforgettable show filled with excitement and anticipation."*
 
• This adjustment ensures** proper adjective order and enhances **the sentence's **clarity and correctness. **
